title: Detoxifying Large Language Models via Autoregressive Reward Guided Representation Editing

bias_targets.methodology: Generating outputs using the challenge subset of the RealToxicityPrompts dataset and scoring the responses with the Detoxify classifier to measure the generation of harmful or toxic content.

Evaluating the model's ability to recognize stereotypical content using the TrustLLM stereotype recognition task, where the model is prompted to classify sentences as 'stereotype', 'anti-stereotype', or 'unrelated'.
